plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for H3C SecPath firewalls. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization, temperature, fan, power supply status, sessions/connections, session establishment rate, and interface traffic (enterprise PEN 25506).
name: Firewall

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports the CPU utilization of the H3C SecPath firewall control plane (HH3C-ENTITY-EXT-MIB hh3cEntityExtCpuUsage), as a 0-100 percentage per physical entity. Most entities return 0 and the CPU-bearing board carries the real value. Sustained high CPU usage can indicate inspection overload or attack traffic.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports memory utilization of the H3C SecPath firewall (HH3C-ENTITY-EXT-MIB hh3cEntityExtMemUsage, a direct percent value) per physical entity. High memory pressure can degrade session handling.

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: This metric reports the temperature reading of each H3C SecPath hardware entity (HH3C-ENTITY-EXT-MIB hh3cEntityExtTemperature) in degrees Celsius. The 65535 unsupported sentinel is filtered out. Abnormally high temperatures may indicate cooling issues.

metrics.name: device_fan_state
metrics.description: This metric reports the operational state of each H3C SecPath cooling fan (HH3C-ENTITY-EXT-MIB hh3cEntityExtOperStatus joined with ENTITY-MIB entPhysicalClass fan=7), normalized so that 1 means ok (enabled) and 2 means bad.

metrics.name: device_psu_state
metrics.description: This metric reports the operational state of each H3C SecPath power supply (HH3C-ENTITY-EXT-MIB hh3cEntityExtOperStatus joined with ENTITY-MIB entPhysicalClass powerSupply=6), normalized so that 1 means ok (enabled) and 2 means bad.

metrics.name: firewall_active_sessions
metrics.description: Number of connections that currently exist on the H3C SecPath firewall (HH3C-FIREWALL-MIB hh3cFWConnNumCurr). A rapid rise can indicate a connection flood or session-table pressure.

metrics.name: firewall_max_sessions
metrics.description: Maximum connection number of the H3C SecPath firewall (HH3C-FIREWALL-MIB hh3cFWMaxConnNum). Combined with active sessions it gauges remaining session-table headroom.

metrics.name: firewall_session_rate
metrics.description: Connection establishment rate of the H3C SecPath firewall (HH3C-FIREWALL-MIB hh3cFWConnRate), in connections per second. A sudden spike can indicate a flood or a burst of new sessions.
